full_judgment: ATM Afzal, J.: Plaintiff-petitioner filed Title Suit No. 301 of 1959 in the First Court of the Assistant Judge, Patuakhali which was dismissed for default whereupon an application under Order 9 rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure was filed for setting the dismissal aside. The resulting Miscellaneous Case No. 407 of 1980 was also dismissed for default and again an application under Order 9 rule 9 read with section 151 CPC was filed for setting aside the dismissal order in the miscellaneous case. Upon objection raised by the defendant the second Miscellaneous Case No. 71 of 1982 was dismissed as not maintainable. The said order was upheld in appeal by the learned Additional District Judge, Patuakhali and then in revision by a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division (Barisal Bench). This petition is from the judgment and order of the learned Single Judge discharging the Rule in Civil Revision No. 125 of 1984.
